summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-derived entry about Joseph J. McCarthy, recording that President Harry S. Truman presented him the Medal of Honor at a White House ceremony on October 5, 1945. It also records a remark Truman made to McCarthy during the presentation, expressing that he would rather have the Medal than be President.
one_line: Account of Joseph J. McCarthy receiving the Medal of Honor from President Harry S. Truman at the White House on October 5, 1945.
key_facts: President Harry S. Truman presented the Medal of Honor to Joseph J. McCarthy.
The Medal of Honor presentation to Joseph J. McCarthy was held in ceremonies at the White House.
The White House ceremony for Joseph J. McCarthy's Medal of Honor was held on October 5, 1945.
During the presentation, Harry S. Truman told Joseph J. McCarthy, "I'd rather have one of these than be President."
